mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and related goods, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy that stimulates economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 5% indicates a strong labor market, which in turn drives consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, above 2% indicates a growing supply of goods, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in personal consumption expenditures, as measured by RSAFS, above 5% indicates a growing demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong personal consumption expenditures growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, above 2% indicates a tightening monetary policy, which in turn leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, above 7% indicates a weak labor market, which in turn leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. However, if the payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, is increasing, it mitigates the negative effect.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment and decreasing payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, above 3% indicates a growing demand for goods and services, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. However, if the inflation rate, as measured by CPIAUCSL, is above 2%, it mitigates the positive effect.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
